subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a new typed agent/default and per-model total generation timeout config, or keep timeout control at provider/run/idle/first-event surfaces?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive public config contract, and automation should not choose the permanent timeout precedence, naming, fallback, and upgrade policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add typed per-model generation timeout
options.body: Define a canonical agents.defaults and agents.defaults.models timeout field, document precedence, and test fallback behavior for mixed fast, slow, thinking, and local models.

options.title: Keep provider/run timeout model
options.body: Leave users on models.providers.<id>.timeoutSeconds plus agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds and clarify docs/support policy instead of adding another config layer.

options.title: Defer behind narrower reliability fixes
options.body: Keep this open while targeted Gemini thinking and repetition-loop safeguards land without committing to a new config surface yet.

recommendation.title: Add typed per-model generation timeout
recommendation.body: Define a canonical agents.defaults and agents.defaults.models timeout field, document precedence, and test fallback behavior for mixed fast, slow, thinking, and local models.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has both adjacent timeout-policy history and direct product review context on this issue.
